payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been changed into a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: complete: the image as a whole is convincingly rendered in a pencil-drawing medium, with pencil-like linework or tonal strokes and drawing-like shading across the scene, rather than merely retaining a photographic rendering with a filter. partial: clear pencil-drawing transformation is present in some or much of the image, but the whole image does not consistently read as a pencil drawing; remaining photographic shading or substantial color may indicate incomplete transformation, not absence of progress. Desaturation, muted tones, or grain/texture alone do not establish completion. absent: no discernible pencil-drawing transformation. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Unrelated edits do not count.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: pencil drawing.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has muted, mostly desaturated colors and a grainy, softened appearance, but the food and surrounding objects retain photographic shading and do not consistently read as pencil linework or drawing-like strokes.","confidence":0.94}
